body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request improves the homepage readability by fixing font color contrast issues and adds a comprehensive blog section using fumadocs. The changes include configuration updates, new blog routing, and two in-depth analytical articles about ObjectStack's architecture and protocol-first philosophy.

**Changes:**
- Fixed homepage font colors from `text-fd-muted-foreground` to `text-fd-foreground/80` and `/70` variants for better readability in light mode
- Configured fumadocs blog collection with custom schema for author, date, and tags
- Added blog navigation link and implemented blog index and individual post pages
- Created two comprehensive technical articles (17,000+ and 23,000+ words) analyzing metadata-driven architecture and protocol-first development

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/docs/source.config.ts | Added blog collection configuration with custom schema for metadata |
| apps/docs/app/source.ts | Exported blog loader alongside docs loader |
| apps/docs/app/layout.config.tsx | Added "Blog" navigation link |
| apps/docs/app/[lang]/page.tsx | Updated text colors for hero subtitle, features, and personas for better contrast |
| apps/docs/app/[lang]/blog/[[...slug]]/page.tsx | Created blog pages with index and individual post rendering |
| content/blog/protocol-first-development.mdx | Added comprehensive article on protocol-first development philosophy |
| content/blog/metadata-driven-architecture.mdx | Added in-depth analysis of metadata-driven architecture patterns |
</details>

The `generateMetadata` function's params type is missing the `lang` parameter that exists in the route. The type should be `params: Promise<{ lang: string; slug?: string[] }>` to match the route structure and the main component's params type.

The conditional logic is incorrect. The expression `!plan.executionStats.totalDocsExamined < plan.executionStats.nReturned * 10` will always evaluate incorrectly due to operator precedence. The `!` operator has higher precedence than `<`, so it evaluates as `(!plan.executionStats.totalDocsExamined) < ...` which is not the intended logic. It should be `!(plan.executionStats.totalDocsExamined < plan.executionStats.nReturned * 10)` or better yet `plan.executionStats.totalDocsExamined >= plan.executionStats.nReturned * 10`.
```suggestion
    if (plan.executionStats.totalDocsExamined >= plan.executionStats.nReturned * 10) {
```

The date schema uses `z.coerce.string()` which is redundant. Since the frontmatter dates are already in string format (e.g., "2024-01-20"), you should use `z.string()` directly. The `.coerce` is unnecessary and can cause unexpected behavior when the date is already a string.
```suggestion
  date: z.string().optional(),
```

The `lang` parameter is extracted from params but never used in the BlogPage component. The component should either use this parameter for internationalization or remove it from the destructuring if it's not needed. Consider whether blog posts should support multiple languages.

The `generateStaticParams` function is missing the `lang` parameter that should be included in the returned objects since the route includes `[lang]` as a dynamic segment. This could cause build errors or missing routes for different languages.
